Title: Goods

Description: Definition of Goods under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

Content:
Term: goods
Legal Definition: means every kind of movable property and includes "food" as defined in clause (j) of sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006;
Plain Language: The Act defines goods as every kind of movable property and expressly includes food. Immovable property such as land or buildings is not included in the definition of goods.
Examples: - a refrigerator purchased from a store
- a packet of biscuits bought from a supermarket
Non Examples: - Immovable property such as land or a building (not covered by the definition of goods)

Keywords: goods, movable property, food, consumer goods, definition, consumer, protection, act, means, every, kind, movable

Aliases: products, commodities, Commodities, Items, Merchandise, Products

Title: Defect

Description: Definition of Defect under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

Content:
Term: defect
Legal Definition: any fault, imperfection or shortcoming in the quality, quantity, potency, purity or standard which is required to be maintained by or under any law for the time being in force or under any contract, express or implied or as is claimed by the trader in any manner whatsoever in relation to any goods or product
Plain Language: a problem or flaw in a product that makes it not meet the required standards or what was promised
Examples: - a phone that does not charge properly
- a food product that is past its expiry date
Non Examples: - A product performing exactly as promised by the trader and as required by law

Keywords: defect, product flaw, quality issue, definition, consumer, protection, act, fault, imperfection, shortcoming, quality, quantity

Aliases: flaw, fault, imperfection, Deficiency, Fault, Flaw, Imperfection, Shortcoming

Title: Right to Compensation

Description: claiming compensation for the harm caused

Content:
Right: Compensation
Conditions: - for the harm caused to him
- negligence of the opposite party
- loss or injury suffered by the consumer
- harm caused by a defective product
- product manufactured by a product manufacturer or serviced by a product service provider or sold by a product seller
- the product contains a manufacturing defect
- the product is defective in design
- there is a deviation from manufacturing specifications
- the product does not conform to the express warranty
- the product fails to contain adequate instructions of correct usage to prevent any harm or any warning regarding improper or incorrect usage
- product seller has exercised substantial control over the product
- he has altered or modified the product and such alteration or modification was the substantial factor in causing the harm
- he has made an express warranty of a product independent of any express warranty made by a manufacturer and such product failed to conform to the express warranty made by the product seller which caused the harm
- product manufacturer is unknown or cannot be served
- product seller has failed to exercise reasonable care
Limitations: - Not specified in the Act
Exceptions: - Not specified in the Act

Keywords: product liability action, compensation, harm, negligence, loss, injury, product liability, compensation claim, defective product, right, claiming, caused

Aliases: right to claim damages, right to damages, right to reparation, right to remedy, right to redress, compensation rights, refund rights, reimbursement rights
